item.text:
Updated [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) to fetch posts with `getPosts()` and render their titles and authors. The cached fetch uses Next.js `use cache`, revalidates after one hour, and carries the `posts` tag for on-demand invalidation.

Enabled Cache Components in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). `npm run build` passes and reports a one hour revalidation interval for the page.
